verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an app marketplace or installable prebuilt integrations for Slack, support desks, marketing tools or data warehouses. It covers only REST API endpoints, which are developer building blocks, and a Gmail/Outlook sync, which is an adjacent feature rather than marketplace installs. An app marketplace is a fair axis for a CRM, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace
